terminal_convention: q1,b is accepting halt; q2,$ is nonaccepting null

mode_encoding.code_serialization: Exact decimal strings, to avoid JSON floating-point rounding
mode_encoding.accepting_target: u = q_accept_final * sum(h), with an admissible post-event germ
mode_encoding.nonaccepting_null_target: u = q_null_final * sum(h), with an admissible post-event germ

integer_event_lift.pivot: j = min J, with J the complete earliest-collision edge set
integer_event_lift.initial_denominator: Q from the explicit two-half loader
integer_event_lift.invariant: h_k = Q * product(previous pivot closing speeds) * g_k
